title: Catching the right train
summary: Platforms, departure times and transfers: enough Japanese to get from Tokyo to Kyoto and on to Nara without boarding the wrong train.
canDo: I can ask which platform a train leaves from and check where it is going.
I can ask and understand departure and arrival times.
I can ask about stops and transfers and buy a reserved or non-reserved seat.

items.front: {何番線|なんばんせん}ですか

items.note: Place + {行|ゆ}き is what the front of the train and the departure board show.
{分|ふん} becomes ぷん after some numbers: {十分|じゅっぷん} ten minutes.
{二時|にじ} is two o'clock; {二時間|にじかん} is a length of time.
{二枚|にまい} two, {三枚|さんまい} three.

lessons.title: Which platform?
lessons.canDo: I can ask which platform my train leaves from and check that a train goes where I want.

intro.scene: A big Tokyo station at rush hour. Leo wants to get to Shibuya.

lines.text: すみません、{渋谷|しぶや}{行|ゆ}き{は|wa}{何番線|なんばんせん}ですか。
lines.meaning: Excuse me, which platform is the train for Shibuya?

lines.text: この{電車|でんしゃ}{は|wa}{渋谷|しぶや}に{行|い}きますか。
lines.meaning: Does this train go to Shibuya?

lines.text: いいえ、それ{は|wa}{新宿|しんじゅく}{行|ゆ}きです。{次|つぎ}の{電車|でんしゃ}です。
lines.meaning: No, that one is for Shinjuku. It's the next train.

lines.text: わかりました。ありがとうございます。

notes.title: 〜{行|ゆ}き
notes.body: Place + {行|ゆ}き = "bound for". It is the word on the front of every train and on every departure board. You will also hear it said いき.

notes.title: {何番線|なんばんせん}
notes.body: {番線|ばんせん} is the platform number: {一番線|いちばんせん}, {二番線|にばんせん}. {何|なん} + {番線|ばんせん} asks "which platform?".

notes.title: Check before you board
notes.body: この{電車|でんしゃ}{は|wa}〜に{行|い}きますか is a yes/no question, so even a quick はい or いいえ tells you what you need.

exercises.prompt: Fill the gap.
exercises.text: {京都|きょうと}{行|ゆ}き{は|wa}___ですか。
exercises.meaning: Which platform is the train for Kyoto?

exercises.prompt: Listen. What are you told?
Build: "Does this train go to Shinjuku?"
exercises.meaning: Does this train go to Shinjuku?
exercises.answer: この{電車|でんしゃ}{は|wa}{新宿|しんじゅく}に{行|い}きますか

exercises.prompt: The board says 東京行き. This train…
exercises.explain: {東京|とうきょう}{行|ゆ}き: bound for Tokyo.

exercises.prompt: The staff member explains and you understand. You say:
exercises.explain: わかりません is "I don't understand". いいですね is "sounds good".

exercises.prompt: Ask in Japanese: "Which platform is it?"
exercises.answer: {何番線|なんばんせん}ですか。
alt: すみません、{何番線|なんばんせん}ですか。

lessons.title: What time does it leave?
lessons.canDo: I can ask and understand train times and say how long a journey takes.

intro.scene: The Shinkansen ticket office. Leo is planning the trip to Kyoto.

lines.text: {次|つぎ}の{新幹線|しんかんせん}{は|wa}{何時|なんじ}ですか。
lines.meaning: What time is the next bullet train?

lines.text: {京都|きょうと}に{何時|なんじ}に{着|つ}きますか。
lines.meaning: What time does it arrive in Kyoto?

lines.text: {十一時四十五分|じゅういちじよんじゅうごふん}に{着|つ}きます。
{東京|とうきょう}から{京都|きょうと}まで{二時間|にじかん}ぐらいですね。
lines.meaning: So Tokyo to Kyoto is about two hours, isn't it?

notes.title: O'clock: 〜{時|じ}
notes.body: Number + {時|じ}. Three hours are irregular: {四時|よじ} 4:00, {七時|しちじ} 7:00, {九時|くじ} 9:00. {半|はん} after the hour means "half past": {九時半|くじはん}.

notes.title: Minutes: 〜{分|ふん}
notes.body: {五分|ごふん} 5 minutes, {十分|じゅっぷん} 10, {十五分|じゅうごふん} 15, {三十分|さんじゅっぷん} 30. On timetables you mostly read digits, so recognising them by ear is what matters.

notes.title: 〜から〜まで, and {時間|じかん}
notes.body: から is the start and まで is the end, for places and for times. {二時|にじ} is two o'clock, but {二時間|にじかん} is two hours long. ぐらい after a number means "about".

exercises.prompt: How do you read 9時 (nine o'clock)?
exercises.explain: One of the three irregular hours: よじ, しちじ, くじ.

exercises.prompt: Listen. What time is it?
Fill the gap.
exercises.text: {東京|とうきょう}___{京都|きょうと}まで{行|い}きます。
exercises.meaning: I'm going from Tokyo to Kyoto.

exercises.prompt: Build: "What time does it arrive in Osaka?"
exercises.meaning: What time does it arrive in Osaka?
exercises.answer: {大阪|おおさか}に{何時|なんじ}に{着|つ}きますか

exercises.prompt: The journey takes two hours. Which one says how long?
exercises.explain: {二時|にじ} is a time on the clock. {二時間|にじかん} is a duration.

exercises.prompt: Ask in Japanese: "What time is it?"
alt: いま{何時|なんじ}ですか。

exercises.prompt: Type what you hear.
Match.

lessons.title: Stops, transfers and seats
lessons.canDo: I can ask whether a train stops somewhere, where to change, and buy the right kind of seat.

intro.scene: Leo wants to go on to Nara, and he would like a seat.

lines.text: すみません、この{電車|でんしゃ}{は|wa}{奈良|なら}に{止|と}まりますか。
lines.meaning: Excuse me, does this train stop at Nara?

lines.text: いいえ、{止|と}まりません。{京都|きょうと}で{乗|の}り{換|か}えます。
lines.meaning: No, it doesn't. You change at Kyoto.

lines.text: {京都|きょうと}で{乗|の}り{換|か}えですね。{指定席|していせき}{は|wa}ありますか。
lines.meaning: Change at Kyoto, right. Are there reserved seats?

lines.text: すみません、{自由席|じゆうせき}だけです。
わかりました。{自由席|じゆうせき}を{一枚|いちまい}ください。
lines.meaning: I see. One non-reserved ticket, please.

notes.title: 〜に{止|と}まりますか
notes.body: {止|と}まります = to stop. The station takes に, the point where the train stops. The answer is {止|と}まります or {止|と}まりません.

notes.title: 〜で{乗|の}り{換|か}えます
notes.body: Changing trains is an action that happens at a place, so the station takes で: {京都|きょうと}で{乗|の}り{換|か}えます. On signs the noun is {乗|の}り{換|か}え.

notes.title: Seats and tickets
notes.body: {指定席|していせき} is a reserved seat; {自由席|じゆうせき} is non-reserved, any free seat in those cars. Tickets are flat, so they are counted with 〜{枚|まい}: {一枚|いちまい}, {二枚|にまい}. だけ means "only".

exercises.prompt: Fill the gap.
exercises.text: {京都|きょうと}___{乗|の}り{換|か}えます。
exercises.explain: The place where an action happens takes で.

exercises.prompt: Listen. What are you told?
exercises.text: この{電車|でんしゃ}{は|wa}{奈良|なら}に{止|と}まりません。
options: This train doesn't stop at Nara.

exercises.prompt: Build: "Two reserved seats, please."
exercises.answer: {指定席|していせき}を{二枚|にまい}ください

exercises.prompt: You have a 自由席 ticket. Where can you sit?
options: Any free seat in the non-reserved cars
Only the seat printed on the ticket
exercises.explain: {自由席|じゆうせき}: "free seating", in the cars marked for it.

exercises.prompt: Which one means "non-reserved seats only"?
options: {自由席|じゆうせき}だけです。
{指定席|していせき}だけです。
{自由席|じゆうせき}もあります。

exercises.prompt: Type in Japanese: "Does it stop?"
alt: ここに{止|と}まりますか。

exercises.prompt: Answer: "No. You change at Kyoto."
exercises.answer: いいえ。{京都|きょうと}で{乗|の}り{換|か}えます

exercises.prompt: Match.

meme.bottom: The train: 新宿行き. I wanted Shibuya.

lessons.title: Reading: Leo goes to Nara
lessons.canDo: I can read a short text about a train journey and answer questions about it in Japanese.

intro.scene: A short text. Read it, listen to it, then answer in Japanese.

sentences.text: レオさん{は|wa}ブラジル{人|じん}です。
{今日|きょう}、{東京|とうきょう}から{京都|きょうと}に{行|い}きます。
sentences.meaning: Today he is going from Tokyo to Kyoto.

sentences.text: {九時半|くじはん}の{新幹線|しんかんせん}です。
{東京駅|とうきょうえき}で{切符|きっぷ}を{買|か}いました。{指定席|していせき}です。
sentences.meaning: He bought a ticket at Tokyo Station. It is a reserved seat.

sentences.text: {新幹線|しんかんせん}{は|wa}{十一時|じゅういちじ}{四十五分|よんじゅうごふん}に{京都|きょうと}に{着|つ}きます。
sentences.meaning: The bullet train arrives in Kyoto at 11:45.

sentences.text: {京都|きょうと}で{乗|の}り{換|か}えます。
{奈良|なら}{行|ゆ}きの{電車|でんしゃ}{は|wa}{三番線|さんばんせん}です。
sentences.meaning: The train for Nara is on platform 3.

sentences.text: {奈良|なら}で{友|とも}だちと{会|あ}います。

exercises.prompt: {新幹線|しんかんせん}{は|wa}{何時|なんじ}ですか。

options: いいえ、{指定席|していせき}です。

lessons.title: Story: The wrong platform
lessons.canDo: I can follow a short spoken story about a journey and answer questions about it in Japanese.

intro.scene: A short story. Listen for the platform numbers and the times.

sentences.text: {昨日|きのう}、レオさん{は|wa}{京都|きょうと}から{大阪|おおさか}に{行|い}きました。
sentences.meaning: Yesterday Leo went from Kyoto to Osaka.

sentences.text: {八時|はちじ}に{駅|えき}に{着|つ}きました。
sentences.meaning: He got to the station at eight o'clock.

sentences.text: すみません、{大阪|おおさか}{行|ゆ}き{は|wa}{何番線|なんばんせん}ですか。
sentences.meaning: Excuse me, which platform is the train for Osaka?

sentences.text: でも、レオさん{は|wa}{三番線|さんばんせん}の{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}りました。
sentences.meaning: But Leo got on the train at platform 3.

sentences.text: その{電車|でんしゃ}{は|wa}{奈良|なら}{行|ゆ}きでした。
sentences.meaning: That train was bound for Nara.

sentences.text: レオさん{は|wa}{奈良|なら}で{乗|の}り{換|か}えました。
{十一時|じゅういちじ}に{大阪|おおさか}に{着|つ}きました。
sentences.meaning: He arrived in Osaka at eleven o'clock.

sentences.text: {友|とも}だち{は|wa}{二時間|にじかん}{待|ま}ちました。
sentences.meaning: His friend waited for two hours.

exercises.prompt: レオさん{は|wa}どこに{行|い}きましたか。
{大阪|おおさか}{行|ゆ}き{は|wa}{何番線|なんばんせん}ですか。
レオさん{は|wa}{何番線|なんばんせん}の{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}りましたか。
options: {十一番線|じゅういちばんせん}
exercises.explain: That is the mistake: he was told platform 2.

exercises.prompt: その{電車|でんしゃ}{は|wa}どこ{行|ゆ}きでしたか。
レオさん{は|wa}{何時|なんじ}に{大阪|おおさか}に{着|つ}きましたか。
{友|とも}だち{は|wa}{何時間|なんじかん}{待|ま}ちましたか。
